hook: GET ME FLOWERS Why don't you get me flowers?
transcript: Why don't you get me flowers? Why should I? Because you love me. I tell you that I love you, and I do things for you. Why do I need to buy plants wrapped in a paper from a store to show that I love you? Everyone does it, Kevin. Everyone is weird.
